metadata.description: Generated TypeScript client for edgeline-api (spec §11.3). src/ is emitted, never hand-edited — see tools/generate-edgeline-api-client.mjs.

generate-client.//: Regenerate src/ from apps/edgeline-api/openapi.json. Named generate-client rather than generate because `nx generate` is the CLI's own command. Dump openapi.json first: cd apps/edgeline-api && uv run python -m edgeline.api.openapi

test.//: Named `test` so it runs inside `npm run check`: it fails when the committed client disagrees with openapi.json, which is what stops a stale client reaching a commit.
